summary: Iteration 3 tested Family Grouping (member_name on credentials + cards) and FAB position fix. Frontend Playwright (390x844 mobile viewport): PIN unlock (1234) OK; Logins tab shows member-tab-all + member-tab-father pills, PNB Net Banking shows Father badge (credential-member-{id}), filter by Father returns exactly ['PNB Net Banking'], search 'Father' matches PNB (member-name search works), Bank category filter still returns 2 items (regression OK); added TEST_Gmail_UI with member Mother → member-tab-mother pill appeared, password toggle reveals 'pw123', delete works; Cards tab shows card-member-tab-* pills, HDFC shows emerald Self badge (card-member-{id}), filter by Self returns only HDFC; added TEST_AXIS with member Brother → card-member-tab-brother pill appeared; Insurance tab unchanged — LIC card visible with Father badge and 'Due in 15 days' reminder banner. action_items: (Carry-over from iter 2, still not fixed) axios interceptor in /app/frontend/src/App.js auto-locks vault on any 401 including /auth/change-pin wrong-old-pin. Suggested one-liner: `if (e.response?.status === 401 && !e.config.url.includes('/auth/change-pin') && localStorage.getItem('vault_token')) lock();`
critical_code_review_comments: CredentialCreate & CardCreate now include member_name with default ''  — clean, backwards compatible (old records default to empty string via Pydantic).
CredentialsTab search now matches title/username/member_name — implementation correct.
Member pill row is conditionally hidden when members.length===0 — good UX, no empty pill bar.
CardsTab uses '{items.length===0 ? "No cards yet" : "No cards for this member"}' empty-state text — correctly disambiguates true-empty vs filter-empty.
FAB is `fixed bottom-6 right-6` and no longer wrapped in a fade-up ancestor with transform (App.css fadeUp changed to opacity-only) — FAB now anchors to viewport (24/24 gaps verified).
member badge testids use item.id suffix (credential-member-{id}, card-member-{id}) — enables per-row assertion.
One nit: CredentialsTab useState(memberFilter) is declared AFTER useEffect(load) which is unusual ordering; harmless but hooks are conventionally grouped at top.

success_rate.frontend: 100% flows exercised — all member grouping + FAB behaviours verified
